purpose: Classify every tool that referenced the retired campaign (outputs/_drive_madrl, outputs/madrl_v3_20260627_164047, outputs/citylearn_v3_madrl_full_20260615_*) after the owner retired it. No file was deleted.
source_command_evaluated_at: before the adaptation commit (52 files; 46 still match afterwards: the 6 adapted files no longer do)
current_results_layout: <results_root>/<run_id>/{evidence.json, experiment.json} and <results_root>/<run_id>/<E1|E1_s<seed>>/{data, figures, figures/tables, checkpoints}; resolved by uc3m/application/evaluation/results_catalog.py (argument, then MADRL_RESULTS_ROOT, then outputs/campaign); only status=verified runs count
derived_outputs_convention: <results_root>/resumen_comparativo/{estadistica/analisis_cuantitativo_completo_50_episodios, multiobjetivo, performance_comparison} (no evidence.json there, so the catalog ignores it)

files.locates_data_via: --results-root/--seed -> campaign_layout(root, seed)[(ALGO, E*)]/data/{results.json, building_kpis.csv, building_behavior_summary.csv, timeseries.csv, trace.csv}; episode_summary.csv of the same run only when results.json does not cover episodes 0..49; output default <root>/resumen_comparativo/estadistica/analisis_cuantitativo_completo_50_episodios; exit 2 naming missing/unverified treatments

--results-root/--seed -> campaign_layout(...)[(ALGO, E*)]/figures/tables/core_kpis.csv and data/results.json; output default <root>/resumen_comparativo; exit 2 and no ranking when a treatment or its core_kpis.csv is missing; no longer writes outputs/latest_colab_output_root.txt

--results-root/--seed -> campaign_layout(...)[(ALGO, E*)]/data/{results.json, building_behavior_summary.csv}; schema from the MATD3/E1 run data/building_observation_action_schema.csv; output default <root>/resumen_comparativo/multiobjetivo; exit 2 on missing treatments or files

--results-root/--seed -> campaign_layout(...) confirms one verified run per treatment and supplies run_id; reads derived tables from <root>/resumen_comparativo/{estadistica/analisis_cuantitativo_completo_50_episodios, multiobjetivo} (overridable); writes only under <root>/resumen_comparativo/performance_comparison (job figures in jobs/, verified run folders are not modified)

default source is --results-root (else MADRL_RESULTS_ROOT, else outputs/campaign) -> campaign_layout(root, seed=k)[(ALGO, E*)]/data/results.json for k in range(--n-seeds); --episodes-csv and legacy --run-root stay explicit; missing data exits 2 instead of silently falling back to illustrative values (illustrative only with --illustrative-only/--smoke)

resolve_run_dir(repo, run_dir) returns the explicit results root or the catalog default root when it has verified runs; episode_summary_path/load_episode_reward_series use campaign_layout(root, seed)[(ALGO, E*)]/figures/tables/episode_summary.csv; district objectives and best_madrl_report from <root>/resumen_comparativo/; illustrative mode unchanged
